summary: Full backend + frontend testing completed for Weddings by Kaarya. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (create/list/get/404/validation on /api/inquiries). Frontend loads through the loader, hero + nav + services (9) + gallery (8) + testimonials + contact all render with proper data-testid attributes. Inquiry form successfully submits to backend and shows success toast; empty-required submission (after removing native HTML required attr to reach app-level guard) shows the expected error toast. Nav smooth-scroll works.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form: HTML5 `required` attributes on inputs cause the browser to block submit before the app-level toast fires. The app-level check (`if (!form.name || !form.email || !form.phone)`) is therefore effectively dead code in normal use. Consider either removing HTML required to rely on toast UX, or removing the JS guard as redundant.

server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo but returns datetime in response model — works but inconsistent; consider storing as native datetime for proper sort ordering (currently sort works because ISO 8601 strings sort lexically).
No pagination/limit query params on GET /api/inquiries (hardcoded 1000).
CORS `allow_origins='*'` combined with `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will ignore credentials. Fine for public site but flag for future auth.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed inquiries via POST /api/inquiries during test runs; not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py; run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_inquiries.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables xdist which breaks module-level shared state via pytest.created_id). Frontend loader waits ~3.5s — sleep >=5s before interacting. Headline text is split into per-letter spans (masked reveal), so plaintext `locator('text=Where Dreams Become Timeless Celebrations')` returns 0; verify via [data-testid='hero-section'] instead. Testimonial slides are keyed as [data-testid='testimonial-{idx}']; no `testimonial-quote` id exists.
